standard_prerequisites: tor amplitude of pulled back complexes (Cohomology on Sites, Lemma sites-cohomology-lemma-tor-amplitude-pullback)
flatness of the site morphism epsilon (lemma-epsilon-flat of the same chapter) and the resulting compatibility epsilon^*(E tensor^L F) = epsilon^*E tensor^L epsilon^*F
the conservative property of epsilon^*: epsilon^*F = 0 implies F = 0 (lemma-epsilon-flat of the same chapter)
core_obligations: Prove that an object E of D(O_X) has tor amplitude in [a, b] if and only if epsilon^*E does, and E has finite tor dimension if and only if epsilon^*E does
proof_roadmap: The forward implication is the standard tor-amplitude behaviour under pullback along the flat morphism epsilon.
For the converse, tensor with an arbitrary O_X-module F and use flatness of epsilon to identify epsilon^*(E tensor^L F) with epsilon^*E tensor^L epsilon^*F.

The assumed vanishing of cohomology on the etale side forces the cohomology sheaves of epsilon^*(E tensor^L F) to vanish outside [a, b], and the conservative property of epsilon^* transfers the vanishing back to E tensor^L F.
difficulty_reason: H3: a descent argument for tor amplitude through flatness and conservativity of the site morphism.
